Shopify Developer
Northbound Commerce

About the role

Northbound Commerce builds and maintains Shopify and Shopify Plus storefronts for mid-market retail brands across Canada. We are hiring a Shopify Developer to join our Toronto delivery team (hybrid, 2 days/week in office).

What you will do

- Build and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Implement responsive, accessible storefront features from Figma designs
- Integrate third-party apps and APIs (reviews, subscriptions, shipping, ERP connectors)
- Use the Shopify Storefront API and Admin API to extend store functionality
- Optimize storefront performance (Core Web Vitals, image pipelines, script audits)
- Implement SEO best practices: structured data, metafields, canonical handling
- Collaborate with designers and project managers in an agile delivery process
- Maintain version control discipline with Git and participate in code reviews

What we are looking for

- 2+ years of professional experience building Shopify themes in production
- Strong Liquid templating skills and deep familiarity with theme architecture
- Solid JavaScript fundamentals (ES6+); experience with React is an asset for embedded app work
- Experience with HTML/CSS at a pixel-precision level
- Comfort working with REST APIs and webhooks
- Experience with performance and SEO optimization on e-commerce storefronts
- Clear written communication with non-technical clients

Nice to have

- Shopify app development experience (Node.js, Express)
- Experience with headless storefronts (Hydrogen, Storefront API)
- Klaviyo, HubSpot, or other marketing platform integrations
- Google Analytics / GA4 and Search Console fluency

Why Northbound

Salary band $70,000-$90,000 CAD, extended health benefits, education budget. You will own client storefronts end-to-end and see your work ship weekly.
